question: README/PREREG 声称 `pytest tests/ -q` 是 15 passed：从测试文件本身数，测试函数几个、参数化展开后收集几条？
verify:
import ast
from pathlib import Path
import tools.code_analyzer as probe          # 用已导入模块定位仓库根，避免依赖 cwd
repo = Path(probe.__file__).resolve().parent.parent
tree = ast.parse((repo / "tests" / "test_analyzer.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
funcs = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith("test_")]
collected = 0
for fn in funcs:
    mult = 1
    for dec in fn.decorator_list:
        if isinstance(dec, ast.Call) and getattr(dec.func, "attr", "") == "parametrize":
            mult *= len(dec.args[1].elts)
    collected += mult
result = f"{len(funcs)}|{collected}"
